description: Recipe requirements.txt pins are part of a reproducible export: a bump can change the published bytes
(quantizer rounding, exporter graphs), and merging one republishes the model. Bump them by hand, with a
check run, when a recipe needs it. Workflow actions still get PRs.

packageRules.description: No PRs for recipe Python pins.
The ortllama acceptance gate (scripts/ortllama/): keep slicc-ortllama pinned exactly.

description: onnxruntime-node in scripts/ortllama/ has to equal slicc-ortllama's exact peer version, or npm ci fails
with ERESOLVE. It moves by hand, in the same commit as a slicc-ortllama bump that changes the peer.
